New Delhi: Anuh Pharma on Monday said it has invested Rs 72.90 crore in a third bulk drug manufacturing facility.

Funded through internal accruals, the facility at Maharashtra's Tarapur will add 525 tonnes per annum capacity and will be fully operational by December, according to a statement.

Source : PTI
